name: web-painterly-photo-cards-ai-agent-landing
title: Serif Headline Landing with Painterly Hero
whatItIs: A pale mint-white landing page in a rounded frame with a large tightly set serif headline, email capture, a painterly illustrated coastal landscape hero with a car and a floating testimonial card, and three feature cards with product UI over landscape imagery.
whatItMeans: The illustrative scene and serif type bring warmth and human trust to a technical product, while clean UI cards keep it credible.
techniques: Tight-tracked large serif headline as the main visual
Painterly landscape as hero backdrop with a testimonial card overlaid
Email-in-hero capture field instead of a button alone
Product UI cards set over blurred landscape crops
Tabbed customer story logos underneath the hero
bestFor: B2B products aimed at non-technical buyers
Brands blending editorial feel and product proof

vocabulary.definition: An inline email input inside the hero.
A quote card floated over the hero image.
